contracts.must: Every measurement/experiment names the decision it can change.
Material engine changes state intended effects, guardrails, feedback/compensating responses and relevant delays.
Unknowns remain explicit; evidence reduces uncertainty but does not become certainty by formatting.
Prefer evidence whose expected decision value exceeds its acquisition cost/latency.
Bound active meta-experiments; captured backlog does not authorize parallel execution.
Prefer the smallest reversible canary that can discriminate between meaningful alternatives.
Shorten feedback loops when doing so does not destroy evidence quality or story truth.
Check whether the system can compensate for or defeat the proposed intervention.
Human interviews avoid compliments/hypotheticals as proof; capture concrete past behavior, constraints and commitment where relevant.
Before consequential change, inspect goal substitution, event-only reasoning, hidden dynamics, delay blindness and mistaken hypotheses.
A reversible change defines rollback trigger and rollback target before canary.
Repeated failure after local repair triggers problem/model/boundary review.
Internal enthusiasm, repeated model agreement, or document volume cannot count as independent supporting evidence.
contracts.source_mechanism: Chancellor REFERENCE ONLY + existing evidence firewall

contracts.must: Changes to the Self-Improvement Engine pass the same candidate→pilot→evidence→promotion lifecycle.
